title: A low-cost quantitative continuous measurement of movements in the extremities of people with Parkinson's disease
author: McKay, Harrigan, et al.

steps.title: Connect USB data‑logger cable
steps.instruction: Plug the standard 6‑foot hi‑speed USB revision 2.0 shielded 28AWG/2C+24AWG/2C (UL) E305668 type CM 75 °C CSA 204790 type CM 75 °C MSL cable from the metal box into the laptop computer.

steps.title: Attach accelerometer boards to cable
steps.instruction: Plug each accelerometer evaluation board into the receptacle on the 16‑foot‑4.5‑inch light, shielded cable from the metal box, aligning the “ST” marking toward the red wire and matching the banded black tape (one, two, three, or four bands) to the designated limb.

steps.title: Launch DataQ and start acquisition
steps.instruction: Start the DataQ software by clicking its desktop icon, then in the “DataQ Instruments Hardware Manager” window click “Start WINDAQ”. Verify that twelve thin dark‑blue horizontal lines (x, y, z for each accelerometer) appear and that none are cyan, which would indicate an incomplete attachment.

steps.title: Place accelerometers on participant
steps.instruction: Instruct the examiner to attach the accelerometer evaluation boards to the participant’s limbs as indicated by the black‑tape labeling.

steps.title: Record sensor data
steps.instruction: In DataQ, select File → Record, enter a file name, set the recording duration appropriate for the protocol item, and click OK to begin recording. The file will be saved on the desktop in the folder “AccData”.

steps.title: Convert recordings to ASCII
steps.instruction: After all motor tasks, on the desktop open the “AccData” folder, double‑click each recorded file to open it in the Waveform Browser, then choose File → Save As, select ASCII output, and click Save. Repeat this conversion for every recording.
